title: Sigiriya
text:
Sigiriya — Overview

The rock fortress of Sigiriya rises about 200 metres above the plains of the Cultural Triangle. King Kashyapa built his palace on the summit in the 5th century; its frescoes and Lion Gate are among Sri Lanka's best-known sights. The neighbouring Dambulla cave temple is a short drive away.

**Tours that visit:** Sigiriya and Minneriya Day Tour from Kandy, Highlights of Sri Lanka, Cultural Triangle Sri Lanka Package, Treasures of Sri Lanka.

title: Minneriya National Park
text:
Minneriya National Park — Overview

Minneriya is famous for "the gathering": in the dry season, roughly August to October, hundreds of elephants come to the shrinking reservoir to drink and graze. Safaris are by jeep in the late afternoon.

**Tours that visit:** Sigiriya and Minneriya Day Tour from Kandy, Highlights of Sri Lanka.

title: Kandy
text:
Kandy — Overview

Kandy was the last royal capital of Sri Lanka. The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic sits beside a calm lake ringed by hills. The Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya are just outside the city.

**Tours that visit:** Kandy City Tour, Kandy Heritage Stay, Highlights of Sri Lanka, Cultural Triangle Sri Lanka Package, Treasures of Sri Lanka.

title: Nuwara Eliya
text:
Nuwara Eliya — Overview

At about 1,900 metres, Nuwara Eliya is the heart of tea country, with a cool climate, colonial buildings, Lake Gregory and a golf course. Nights can be cold.

**Tours that visit:** Train and Day Tour from Kandy to Nuwara Eliya, Highlights of Sri Lanka, Treasures of Sri Lanka.

title: Ella
text:
Ella — Overview

A relaxed hill town known for the Nine Arches Bridge, Little Adam's Peak and some of the most scenic stretches of the hill-country railway.

**Tours that visit:** Instafamous Sri Lanka, Treasures of Sri Lanka.

title: Yala National Park
text:
Yala National Park — Overview

Yala, in the dry south-east, has one of the highest densities of leopards in the world, as well as elephants, sloth bears, crocodiles and over 200 bird species. Safaris run at dawn and in the late afternoon.

**Tours that visit:** Wildlife Photography Tour, Treasures of Sri Lanka.

title: Galle
text:
Galle — Overview

Galle Fort is a walled 17th-century town on the south-west coast and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, full of boutique hotels, cafés, galleries and churches.

**Tours that visit:** Galle Fort Walking Tour, Highlights of Sri Lanka, Treasures of Sri Lanka.

title: Mirissa
text:
Mirissa — Overview

Mirissa is a crescent-shaped beach on the south coast, known for blue-whale and dolphin watching between November and April, surf breaks and Coconut Tree Hill at sunset.



**Tours that visit:** Whale and Dolphin Watching Tour in Mirissa, Sri Lanka Beach Stay – Mirissa.

title: Anuradhapura
text:
Anuradhapura — Overview

Sri Lanka's first great capital, founded in the 4th century BCE. Its sacred city holds the Sri Maha Bodhi tree and vast dagobas such as Ruwanwelisaya. It is best explored by bicycle.

**Tours that visit:** Cultural Triangle Sri Lanka Package, Treasures of Sri Lanka.

title: Colombo
text:
Colombo — Overview

Sri Lanka's commercial capital: the colonial Fort district, Pettah's markets, Gangaramaya Temple and the seafront at Galle Face Green.

**Tours that visit:** Colombo City Tour, Highlights of Sri Lanka.
